blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) has dismantled an alleged scam hub in Subic, Olongapo, and secured around 200 Vietnamese nationals. In a statement on Friday, the NBI said agents from its Pampanga District Office conducted the operation on Thursday, following the issuance of a search warrant by Regional Trial Court Branch 73 in Olongapo City. READ: Scam hubs’ ‘resurgence’ seen linked to abuse of visa-free policy Authorities seized computers, mobile phones, and documents believed to have been used in the scamming operation.
